title.narrative: Agricultural Commercialization through Climate Smart Inclusive Innovations

description.narrative: Sustainable and inclusive agricultural commercialization to increase farmer incomes and resilience and improve national food security and thereby also contribute to durable solutions for IDPs and self-reliance for refugees.

tag.narrative: Promote development-oriented policies that support productive activities, decent job creation, entrepreneurship, creativity and innovation, and encourage the formalization and growth of micro-, small- and medium-sized enterprises, including through access to financial services
